newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China will sell shares in some state-owned enterprises to adjust economic structure and develop pillar industries. Article says state will use funds raised from the sale of these shares to upgrade technology and close the gap between developed coastal regions and laggard interior.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Only 12.93 percent of 70 Shanghai state-owned enterprises surveyed signed contracts when doing business with other companies. This resulted in lack of direction and coordination in production.
